description: Deletes a draft or paper-money strategy by archiving it together with its saved backtest; it can be restored within 30 days (acubic_restore_strategy). A strategy with a broker connection is removed on acubic.ai. The person is asked to confirm, or the result gives a confirm_token to pass back once they agree. To stop a running backtest use acubic_cancel_backtest.

confirm_token.description: For clients without elicitation: the confirm_token from the first call's confirmation_required result, sent once the person agreed.

strategy_id.description: The draft or paper-money strategy to delete.

name: acubic_delete_strategy

archived_with.description: What was archived along with the strategy and comes back with a restore.

deleted.description: False when the confirmation was declined: nothing changed.

restore_url.description: Signed-in page that restores the strategy; valid for restorable_days.

title: Delete an agent
